package.name: cobraflex_teleop_gui
package.description:
Qt teleoperation window for the CobraFlex chassis: a button pad, a virtual joystick and a pair of velocity sliders, all publishing geometry_msgs/Twist on cmd_vel.
It is a package of its own rather than another executable inside cobraflex so that PyQt5 stays out of the dependency set of the package every machine needs. Nothing else in the workspace depends on this one, and a robot that is never driven by hand does not have to build it.
